Definition: from G4592; to distinguish, i.e. mark (for avoidance):--note.
BiblicalUsage: Semeioo is marking, noting a man for avoidance: if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed. The Greek text behind the King James Version reads the active form here, while the text I have checked reads the middle form of the same verb.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that noting is not shunning for spite — it is done so the man may be ashamed, and ashamed means he may come back.
